name: tpl-chain-response-3-nogoal
task: If the box falls, the very next move must pick it up again. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) hard matches 'the very next move must pick it up again', since holding_box on the next step is only reachable by a pickup after a fall. Response(at_exit, holding_box) hard matches 'if you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box', with at_exit occurring only on the last step. Both are rules with no added goal, so the rule-only warning is valid.

texts: If the box falls, the very next step must be a pickup that makes the agent carry it again.
If the agent reaches the exit, the agent must be carrying the box at that moment.
